title: Three clean EU runners after excluding contaminated 207
status: kept green at 40k and 60k; still under-driven on 3-runner topology
inventory_note: The checked-in inventory still referenced root@203.0.113.11 during item 274. The actual runner pool for these runs was supplied explicitly via LOADTEST_EXTERNAL_RUNNER_HOSTS and excluded it.

topology.mapping_note: loadtest_live_network_multi_ingress.sh assigns ext_hosts[endpoint_index % host_count] after incrementing endpoint_index, so the first endpoint lands on host index 1.

attempts.name: 274a-three-eu-runners-40k-60s-green
attempts.command: LOADTEST_RUNNER_SSH_OPTS='-i ~/.ssh/id_n2_ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no' LOADTEST_EXTERNAL_RUNNER_HOSTS='root@203.0.113.10 root@203.0.113.12 root@203.0.113.13' LOADTEST_WRITER_SEED_TAG=270 LOADTEST_SEED_CONCURRENCY=16 LOADTEST_REMOTE_CACHE_DIR=/var/tmp/kombat-loadgen-cache LOADTEST_PAYLOAD_CACHE=1 LOADTEST_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/and-live-274a-three-eu-runners-40k-60s LOADTEST_DRAIN_SECS=30 LOADTEST_BATCH_SIZE=8 LOADTEST_PIPELINE_DEPTH=4 LOADTEST_STRICT_NONCE_RETRY=0 LOADTEST_FAIL_ON_ERRORS=1 bash chain/scripts/loadtest_live_network_multi_ingress.sh /tmp/and-live-testnet 32 40000 60
attempts.reason: Clean reset and verify passed. The run finished with zero RPC/nonce/network errors, full convergence, shared state root, and drained relay plus Mahi queues.

attempts.name: 274b-three-eu-runners-60k-60s-green-underdriven
attempts.command: LOADTEST_RUNNER_SSH_OPTS='-i ~/.ssh/id_n2_ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no' LOADTEST_EXTERNAL_RUNNER_HOSTS='root@203.0.113.10 root@203.0.113.12 root@203.0.113.13' LOADTEST_WRITER_SEED_TAG=270 LOADTEST_SEED_CONCURRENCY=16 LOADTEST_REMOTE_CACHE_DIR=/var/tmp/kombat-loadgen-cache LOADTEST_PAYLOAD_CACHE=1 LOADTEST_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/and-live-274b-three-eu-runners-60k-60s LOADTEST_DRAIN_SECS=30 LOADTEST_BATCH_SIZE=8 LOADTEST_PIPELINE_DEPTH=4 LOADTEST_STRICT_NONCE_RETRY=0 LOADTEST_FAIL_ON_ERRORS=1 bash chain/scripts/loadtest_live_network_multi_ingress.sh /tmp/and-live-testnet 32 60000 60
attempts.reason: The run stayed clean and drained fully, but delivery plateaued well below 60k offered. Validators 1-2 were materially weaker than validators 3-4, so the 3-runner topology is still limiting load delivery even though chain correctness remained green.

runner_observations: Removing root@203.0.113.11 immediately restored green throughput versus item 273: 274a produced 39,060.3 committed TPS at 40k offered instead of 28,237.2.
Both 274a and 274b captured substantial kombat_loadgen CPU burn in runner profile snapshots, confirming the runners were actively driving the ingress endpoints during the load window.

The 3-runner pool still creates a deterministic topology artifact because every :8645 ingress maps to root@203.0.113.12, every :8646 ingress maps to root@203.0.113.13, and every :8647 ingress maps to root@203.0.113.10.
274b no longer reproduced item 270b's validator-2 residual mahi_pre_admitted_pool tail. All validators converged, shared state root, and drained to zero after settle.
conclusion: The recent live regression was primarily runner-side, not a proven node correctness issue. Excluding root@203.0.113.11 recovers a new green live TPS on current main, but the 3-runner topology is still under-driving offered load and should not be treated as the chain ceiling. The next rung should add a fourth dedicated EU runner and rerun the clean-reset ladder.
